title: Vegan Rum Crumble Bars
description: A twist on the classic crumble bars, made with a rum-infused filling and a crunchy topping.
instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Line an 8-inch square baking dish with parchment paper.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, sugar, and nutmeg.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond milk, coconut oil, and vanilla extract.
4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
5. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and smooth the top.
6. In a separate bowl, mix together the crumbles and 1 tablespoon of sugar.
7. Sprinkle the crumble mixture evenly over the top of the filling.
8. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and the filling is set.
9. Remove from the oven and let cool completely before cutting into bars.
